business_summary: BExcellent Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the provisions of private supplementary secondary school education services in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. The company offers private supplementary secondary school education services for students from secondary 1 to secondary 6 under the Beacon College brand; and private secondary day school services under the Beacon Day School brand. It also provides school services under the Diverse Learning Club and Hong Kong Beacon International Education brands; and various ancillary education services and products, including IELTS and foreign language courses under the Beacon BExcellent brand, mock examination, and VIP self-study, as well as tutorial and consultation services, interview preparation, and language and supplementary primary school education under the Beacon Childhood, BeConfident, Glocal Education, and Mathgic brands. In addition, the company offers online retail stores under the Beacon Living brand; online learning platforms under the CourseZ brand; overseas study consultation services under the GES brand; online course scheduling and management services; certificate and diploma courses under the Beacon CAPE brand; top-up degrees, professional or vocational training, on-the-job English training, professional examination courses; and other educational services under the Ascent Prep brand. Further, it provides childhood education services; school business management services; travel tour services; and information technology services, as well as operates an advertising agency and various teaching centers. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong. BExcellent Group Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Beacon Enterprise Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 BExcellent Group Holdings Limited는 홍콩과 중국에서 사립보충중등학교 교육 서비스 제공에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 Beacon College 브랜드로 중등 1학년부터 중등 6학년까지의 학생들을 위한 사립 중등학교 교육 서비스를 제공합니다. Beacon Day School 브랜드의 사립 중등 학교 서비스. 또한 Diverse Learning Club 및 Hong Kong Beacon International Education 브랜드로 학교 서비스를 제공합니다. Beacon BExcellent 브랜드의 IELTS 및 외국어 코스, 모의고사, VIP 자율 학습을 포함한 다양한 보조 교육 서비스 및 제품뿐만 아니라 Beacon Childhood, BeConfident, Glocal Education 및 Mathgic 브랜드의 튜토리얼 및 상담 서비스, 인터뷰 준비, 언어 및 초등 보충 교육도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 Beacon Living 브랜드로 온라인 소매점을 제공합니다.
